comments.text:
The RTX might not be another RX 6500 XT but it does move the goalposts for entry-level GPU pricing yet again.  But if it WAS available for MSRP somewhere, would you consider buying one?

Also, just to be perfectly candid the card we and other reviewers were sent had the incorrect BIOS.  We received the reference clocked EVGA XC Black Edition but the BIOS on the card was for the standard pre-overclocked XC.  ALL of the benchmarks were updated with the proper BIOS prior to posting this video.  - Mike
